sentences.zh: 今天比昨天冷。
sentences.en: Today is colder than yesterday.

sentences.zh: 臺灣的夏天比這裡的夏天熱。
sentences.en: Summer in Taiwan is hotter than summer here.

sentences.zh: 我哥哥比我大。
sentences.en: My older brother is older than I am.

sentences.zh: 這裡的冬天比臺灣的冬天冷。
sentences.en: Winter here is colder than winter in Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 春天比夏天舒服。
sentences.en: Spring is more comfortable than summer.

sentences.zh: 今天的天氣比昨天好。
sentences.en: Today's weather is better than yesterday's.

sentences.zh: 我太太比我忙。
sentences.en: My wife is busier than I am.

sentences.zh: 夏天太熱了。
sentences.en: Summer is too hot.

sentences.zh: 今天太冷了，我不想出來。
sentences.en: It is too cold today; I don't want to come out.

sentences.zh: 這裡的冬天太冷了，我不喜歡。
sentences.en: Winter here is too cold; I don't like it.

sentences.zh: 太好了，明天是晴天！
sentences.en: Great, tomorrow will be sunny!

sentences.zh: 下雨的時候，跑步太麻煩了。
sentences.en: When it rains, running is too much trouble.

sentences.zh: 下雨的時候，我不能出來跑步。
sentences.en: When it rains, I can't come out to run.

sentences.zh: 明天你能來嗎？
sentences.en: Can you come tomorrow?

sentences.zh: 我今天不能打網球，我很忙。
sentences.en: I can't play tennis today; I'm busy.

sentences.zh: 你能給我電話號碼嗎？
sentences.en: Can you give me your phone number?

sentences.zh: 明天可能會下雨。
sentences.en: It will probably rain tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 明天會比今天冷。
sentences.en: Tomorrow will be colder than today.

sentences.zh: 天氣預報說明天會下雪。
sentences.en: The weather forecast says it will snow tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 我希望明天會是晴天。
sentences.en: I hope tomorrow will be a sunny day.

sentences.zh: 我明天一定會來。
sentences.en: I will definitely come tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 她可能不會來。
sentences.en: She probably won't come.

sentences.zh: 春天比夏天舒服，也比冬天舒服。
sentences.en: Spring is more comfortable than summer, and than winter.

sentences.zh: 臺灣的冬天不太冷，可是下雨太麻煩了。
sentences.en: Winters in Taiwan are not very cold, but the rain is too much trouble.

sentences.zh: 昨天比今天冷，我不能出來跑步。
sentences.en: Yesterday was colder than today, so I couldn't come out to run.

sentences.zh: 我要給爸爸買一個背包。
sentences.en: I am going to buy a backpack for my dad.

sentences.zh: 她想給她先生買一件衣服。
sentences.en: She wants to buy a piece of clothing for her husband.

sentences.zh: 我要給媽媽買一盒巧克力。
sentences.en: I want to buy my mom a box of chocolates.

sentences.zh: 我想給弟弟買一雙運動鞋。
sentences.en: I want to buy a pair of sports shoes for my younger brother.

sentences.zh: 他想給太太買太陽眼鏡。
sentences.en: He wants to buy his wife sunglasses.

sentences.zh: 你想給家人買什麼禮物？
sentences.en: What gifts do you want to buy for your family?

sentences.zh: 我想給我父母做牛肉麵。
sentences.en: I want to make beef noodle soup for my parents.

sentences.zh: 明文想給家文買帽子。
sentences.en: Mingwen wants to buy a hat for Jiawen.

sentences.zh: 下星期三我們去逛街。
sentences.en: We are going shopping next Wednesday.

sentences.zh: 上個月我去臺灣旅行了。
sentences.en: Last month I went travelling in Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 去年我在臺灣工作，今年我在美國工作。
sentences.en: Last year I worked in Taiwan; this year I work in the U.S.

sentences.zh: 明年我想去法國旅行。
sentences.en: Next year I want to travel to France.

sentences.zh: 這個星期天你有空嗎？
sentences.en: Are you free this Sunday?

sentences.zh: 下個月五號是我的生日。
sentences.en: The fifth of next month is my birthday.

sentences.zh: 上星期我們去百貨公司買東西。
sentences.en: Last week we went to the department store to shop.

sentences.zh: 這個背包又大又便宜。
sentences.en: This backpack is both big and inexpensive.

sentences.zh: 網路商店的東西又便宜又方便。
sentences.en: Things from online stores are both cheap and convenient.

sentences.zh: 她又高興又累。
sentences.en: She is both happy and tired.

sentences.zh: 這件衣服又大又貴。
sentences.en: This piece of clothing is both big and expensive.

sentences.zh: 這家百貨公司的東西又好又便宜。
sentences.en: The things in this department store are good and cheap.

sentences.zh: 因為我今天有空，所以想去逛街。
sentences.en: Because I am free today, I want to go shopping.

sentences.zh: 因為網路商店的東西比較便宜，所以我常常上網買東西。
sentences.en: Because things in online stores are cheaper, I often shop online.

sentences.zh: 因為明天是媽媽的生日，所以我想給她買禮物。
sentences.en: Because tomorrow is my mom's birthday, I want to buy her a gift.

sentences.zh: 因為昨天很忙，所以我今天想休息。
sentences.en: Because I was busy yesterday, I want to rest today.

sentences.zh: 因為這裡的百貨公司太貴了，所以我常常上網買東西。
sentences.en: Because the department stores here are too expensive, I often shop online.

sentences.zh: 我什麼魚都愛吃。
sentences.en: I love to eat every kind of fish.

sentences.zh: 他什麼青菜都不吃。
sentences.en: He doesn't eat any green vegetables at all.

sentences.zh: 我什麼都不想做。
sentences.en: I don't feel like doing anything.

sentences.zh: 誰都不想做飯。
sentences.en: Nobody feels like cooking.

sentences.zh: 她什麼時候都有空。
sentences.en: She is free any time.

sentences.zh: 我們哪裡都不想去。
sentences.en: We don't want to go anywhere.

sentences.zh: 弟弟什麼飯都愛吃，可是不吃辣的。
sentences.en: My younger brother loves every kind of food, but he doesn't eat spicy things.

sentences.zh: 我什麼湯都想喝。
sentences.en: I want to drink every kind of soup.

sentences.zh: 你要吃白飯還是包子？
sentences.en: Do you want steamed rice or steamed buns?

sentences.zh: 你喝啤酒還是咖啡？
sentences.en: Do you drink beer or coffee?

sentences.zh: 我們點炸豆腐還是炒青菜？
sentences.en: Shall we order fried tofu or stir-fried vegetables?

sentences.zh: 你想去餐廳吃還是在家吃？
sentences.en: Do you want to eat at a restaurant or at home?

sentences.zh: 你喜歡秋天還是冬天？
sentences.en: Do you like fall or winter?

sentences.zh: 這碗湯酸還是辣？
sentences.en: Is this bowl of soup sour or spicy?

sentences.zh: 你要一盤炸豆腐還是一碗酸辣湯？
sentences.en: Do you want a plate of fried tofu or a bowl of hot and sour soup?

sentences.zh: 你想今天去還是明天去？
sentences.en: Do you want to go today or tomorrow?

sentences.zh: 我們點一盤炒青菜吧。
sentences.en: Let's order a plate of stir-fried vegetables.

sentences.zh: 我們下午去吃牛肉麵吧！
sentences.en: Let's go eat beef noodle soup this afternoon!

sentences.zh: 你喝一瓶啤酒吧。
sentences.en: Why don't you have a bottle of beer.

sentences.zh: 今天我做飯，你休息吧。
sentences.en: I'll cook today; you take a rest.

sentences.zh: 我們一起去逛街吧。
sentences.en: Let's go shopping together.

sentences.zh: 我們現在點菜吧。
sentences.en: Let's order now.

sentences.zh: 你吃一個豆沙包吧，非常好吃。
sentences.en: Have a red-bean bun; it's really delicious.

sentences.zh: 聽說這家餐廳的紅燒魚非常好吃，我們去吃吧。
sentences.en: I hear the braised fish at this restaurant is really delicious; let's go.

sentences.zh: 你要熱的還是冰的？
sentences.en: Do you want the hot one or the iced one?

sentences.zh: 我要冰的。
sentences.en: I'd like the iced one.

sentences.zh: 這件衣服太小了，我要大的。
sentences.en: This piece of clothing is too small; I want a big one.

sentences.zh: 我喜歡甜的，不喜歡鹹的。
sentences.en: I like sweet ones and don't like salty ones.

sentences.zh: 這兩個包子，你要甜的還是鹹的？
sentences.en: Of these two buns, do you want the sweet one or the salty one?

sentences.zh: 我不要大的，我要小的。
sentences.en: I don't want the big one; I want the small one.

sentences.zh: 咖啡我要熱的，牛奶我要冰的。
sentences.en: I'd like my coffee hot and my milk cold.

sentences.zh: 這杯是熱的，那杯是冰的。
sentences.en: This cup is hot and that one is iced.

sentences.zh: 你要小杯的還是大杯的？
sentences.en: Do you want a small cup or a large cup?

sentences.zh: 如果你有空，我們就去喝咖啡。
sentences.en: If you are free, we'll go have coffee.

sentences.zh: 如果明天下雨，我就不去跑步。
sentences.en: If it rains tomorrow, I won't go running.

sentences.zh: 如果你太累，就休息一下吧。
sentences.en: If you are too tired, just take a short rest.

sentences.zh: 如果天氣太熱，我就喝冰水。
sentences.en: If the weather is too hot, I drink iced water.

sentences.zh: 如果你想喝咖啡，就點一杯熱的。
sentences.en: If you want coffee, order a hot one.

sentences.zh: 如果你喜歡甜的，就點巧克力蛋糕。
sentences.en: If you like sweet things, order the chocolate cake.

sentences.zh: 如果我去臺灣，就給你買禮物。
sentences.en: If I go to Taiwan, I'll buy you a gift.

sentences.zh: 如果你要加糖，就說一下。
sentences.en: If you want sugar added, just say so.

sentences.zh: 他的背包跟我的一樣。
sentences.en: His backpack is the same as mine.

sentences.zh: 中文跟法文一樣難。
sentences.en: Mandarin is just as hard as French.

sentences.zh: 我的咖啡跟你的一樣。
sentences.en: My coffee is the same as yours.

sentences.zh: 這杯紅茶跟那杯紅茶一樣好喝。
sentences.en: This cup of black tea tastes just as good as that one.

sentences.zh: 這家店的蛋糕跟那家店的一樣貴。
sentences.en: The cakes at this shop are as expensive as those at that shop.

sentences.zh: 我的生日跟我哥哥的一樣，都是五月二十號。
sentences.en: My birthday is the same as my older brother's: May 20th.

sentences.zh: 她跟我一樣，都喜歡喝熱的。
sentences.en: She is like me; we both like to drink hot ones.

sentences.zh: 臺灣的夏天跟這裡的夏天一樣熱。
sentences.en: Summer in Taiwan is as hot as summer here.

sentences.zh: 天氣熱了。
sentences.en: The weather has turned hot.

sentences.zh: 我最近胖了。
sentences.en: I have gained weight lately.

sentences.zh: 他不喝咖啡了。
sentences.en: He doesn't drink coffee any more.

sentences.zh: 她現在不吃肉了。
sentences.en: She doesn't eat meat any more.

sentences.zh: 這件外套小了，我要大的。
sentences.en: This coat has become small; I want a bigger one.

sentences.zh: 我們現在不住在這裡了。
sentences.en: We don't live here any more.

sentences.zh: 這雙運動鞋小了，我要再買一雙。
sentences.en: These sports shoes have got too small; I need another pair.

sentences.zh: 最近天氣熱了，我常常喝冰水。
sentences.en: It's gotten hot lately, so I often drink iced water.

sentences.zh: 我不看電視了，我要休息。
sentences.en: I'm not watching TV any more; I want to rest.

sentences.zh: 現在有空了，我們去逛街吧。
sentences.en: Now that I'm free, let's go shopping.

sentences.zh: 雖然這條裙子很好看，可是太貴了。
sentences.en: Although this skirt looks nice, it is too expensive.

sentences.zh: 雖然這件外套很便宜，可是樣子不好看。
sentences.en: Although this coat is cheap, the style is not nice.

sentences.zh: 雖然我很忙，可是我想去逛街。
sentences.en: Although I'm busy, I want to go shopping.

sentences.zh: 雖然今天很冷，可是我想出來跑步。
sentences.en: Although it's cold today, I want to come out and run.

sentences.zh: 雖然這雙鞋很好看，可是我不能穿。
sentences.en: Although these shoes are nice, I can't wear them.

sentences.zh: 雖然那家店的東西很便宜，可是樣子都不好看。
sentences.en: Although things at that shop are cheap, the styles are all unattractive.

sentences.zh: 雖然我喜歡藍色，可是我最近都穿黑色。
sentences.en: Although I like blue, lately I've been wearing black.

sentences.zh: 雖然你不能付現金，可是你可以刷卡。
sentences.en: Although you can't pay cash, you can use a card.

sentences.zh: 雖然她不喜歡咖啡，可是她想試一下。
sentences.en: Although she doesn't like coffee, she wants to try it.

sentences.zh: 這件外套一共四百五十塊。
sentences.en: This coat is 450 dollars altogether.

sentences.zh: 這條長褲三百九十塊。
sentences.en: These pants are 390 dollars.

sentences.zh: 一杯咖啡五十五塊。
sentences.en: A cup of coffee is 55 dollars.

sentences.zh: 一共二十三塊五毛。
sentences.en: That's 23 dollars and 50 cents altogether.

sentences.zh: 這件運動衫四十五塊六毛八分錢。
sentences.en: This T-shirt is 45 dollars 68 cents.

sentences.zh: 我要付三百塊現金。
sentences.en: I'll pay 300 dollars in cash.

sentences.zh: 我家離公園很近。
sentences.en: My home is very close to the park.

sentences.zh: 我家離學校很遠。
sentences.en: My home is far from the school.

sentences.zh: 超級市場離我家不遠。
sentences.en: The supermarket is not far from my home.

sentences.zh: 這家百貨公司離我的公司很近。
sentences.en: This department store is very close to my company.

sentences.zh: 我的學校離銀行很近。
sentences.en: My school is very close to the bank.

sentences.zh: 你家離游泳池遠不遠？
sentences.en: Is your home far from the swimming pool?

sentences.zh: 那個社區離東區不太遠。
sentences.en: That neighborhood is not very far from the eastern district.

sentences.zh: 從我家到學校，開車要二十分鐘。
sentences.en: From my home to school it takes twenty minutes by car.

sentences.zh: 從這裡到公園，走路要五分鐘。
sentences.en: It takes five minutes to walk from here to the park.

sentences.zh: 從我家到超級市場很近。
sentences.en: From my home to the supermarket is close.

sentences.zh: 從南區到東區，開車要多久？
sentences.en: How long does it take to drive from the southern district to the eastern district?

sentences.zh: 從公司到我家，走路要一個鐘頭。
sentences.en: From the company to my home it takes an hour on foot.

sentences.zh: 從我家到那個地方，開車要三十分鐘。
sentences.en: From my home to that place is thirty minutes by car.

sentences.zh: 從學校到銀行，走路要十分鐘。
sentences.en: From the school to the bank it's ten minutes on foot.

sentences.zh: 從這個城市到那個城市，開車要多久？
sentences.en: How long is the drive from this city to that city?

sentences.zh: 他每天學中文，學兩個鐘頭。
sentences.en: He studies Chinese for two hours every day.

sentences.zh: 我每天走路，走三十分鐘。
sentences.en: I walk thirty minutes every day.

sentences.zh: 她每天看電視，看一個鐘頭。
sentences.en: She watches TV for an hour every day.

sentences.zh: 我哥哥每天游泳，游一個鐘頭。
sentences.en: My older brother swims for an hour every day.

sentences.zh: 我每天走路去公司，要走二十分鐘。
sentences.en: I walk to the office every day; it takes twenty minutes.

sentences.zh: 我想在臺灣住一年。
sentences.en: I want to live in Taiwan for a year.

sentences.zh: 他們每天練習說話，練習四十分鐘。
sentences.en: They practise speaking for forty minutes every day.

sentences.zh: 我住的地方離公園很近。
sentences.en: The place where I live is very close to the park.

sentences.zh: 我太太做的蛋糕很好吃。
sentences.en: The cake my wife made is delicious.

sentences.zh: 我喜歡買菜的地方。
sentences.en: I like the place where I buy vegetables.

sentences.zh: 他現在住的地方很小。
sentences.en: The place he lives in now is small.

sentences.zh: 這是我哥哥買的蘋果。
sentences.en: These are the apples my older brother bought.

sentences.zh: 在銀行工作的人是我哥哥。
sentences.en: The person who works at the bank is my older brother.

sentences.zh: 銀行在學校的對面。
sentences.en: The bank is across from the school.

sentences.zh: 我家的後面有一個公園。
sentences.en: There is a park behind my home.

sentences.zh: 房子的前面有一個游泳池。
sentences.en: There is a swimming pool in front of the house.

sentences.zh: 廚房在客廳的旁邊。
sentences.en: The kitchen is next to the living room.

sentences.zh: 浴室在樓上，廚房在樓下。
sentences.en: The bathroom is upstairs and the kitchen is downstairs.

sentences.zh: 我的房間在樓上，我哥哥的房間在樓下。
sentences.en: My room is upstairs and my older brother's room is downstairs.

sentences.zh: 請進！客廳在你的左邊。
sentences.en: Please come in! The living room is on your left.

sentences.zh: 水果在廚房裡面。
sentences.en: The fruit is inside the kitchen.

sentences.zh: 學校的右邊是銀行，左邊是公園。
sentences.en: To the right of the school is the bank, to the left is the park.

sentences.zh: 超級市場在游泳池旁邊。
sentences.en: The supermarket is next to the swimming pool.

sentences.zh: 咖啡店在百貨公司的外面。
sentences.en: The coffee shop is outside the department store.

sentences.zh: 公園的前面是一家餐廳。
sentences.en: In front of the park is a restaurant.

sentences.zh: 我家在公園的對面。
sentences.en: My home is across from the park.

sentences.zh: 游泳池在我家的後面。
sentences.en: The swimming pool is behind my home.

sentences.zh: 學校在銀行的右邊。
sentences.en: The school is to the right of the bank.

sentences.zh: 李老師的家在我家左邊。
sentences.en: Teacher Li's home is to the left of mine.

sentences.zh: 你家在哪裡？我家在超級市場的後面。
sentences.en: Where is your home? My home is behind the supermarket.

sentences.zh: 他的辦公室在公司的樓上。
sentences.en: His office is upstairs in the company.

sentences.zh: 這家餐廳在百貨公司的下面。
sentences.en: This restaurant is below the department store.

sentences.zh: 他家有十幾個房間。
sentences.en: His house has a dozen or so rooms.

sentences.zh: 這個社區有十幾家商店。
sentences.en: This neighborhood has a dozen or so shops.

sentences.zh: 請等幾分鐘。
sentences.en: Please wait a few minutes.

sentences.zh: 這家餐廳有二十幾個人。
sentences.en: There are twenty-some people in this restaurant.

sentences.zh: 他來臺灣十幾年了。
sentences.en: He came to Taiwan more than ten years ago.

sentences.zh: 我們公司有三十幾個人。
sentences.en: Our company has thirty-some people.

sentences.zh: 我想買幾個蘋果。
sentences.en: I want to buy a few apples.

sentences.zh: 我早上先洗澡，然後吃早飯。
sentences.en: In the morning I first take a shower, then eat breakfast.

sentences.zh: 她先起床，然後洗頭髮。
sentences.en: She gets up first, then washes her hair.

sentences.zh: 我下班以後，先去買菜，然後做晚飯。
sentences.en: After work I first go grocery shopping, then cook dinner.

sentences.zh: 他先喝咖啡，然後看書。
sentences.en: He first drinks coffee, then reads.

sentences.zh: 你先吃飯，然後休息一下吧。
sentences.en: Eat first, then take a little rest.

sentences.zh: 我們先去超級市場買菜，然後在家做飯。
sentences.en: We first go to the supermarket to buy groceries, then cook at home.

sentences.zh: 她每天先帶狗去散步，然後上班。
sentences.en: Every day she first takes the dog for a walk, then goes to work.

sentences.zh: 我明天先去銀行，然後去百貨公司。
sentences.en: Tomorrow I'll go to the bank first, then the department store.

sentences.zh: 我吃早飯了。
sentences.en: I have eaten breakfast.

sentences.zh: 李小姐去日本了。
sentences.en: Miss Li went to Japan.

sentences.zh: 我喝了三杯果汁。
sentences.en: I drank three glasses of juice.

sentences.zh: 她買了兩件外套。
sentences.en: She bought two coats.

sentences.zh: 我們看了兩個鐘頭的電影。
sentences.en: We watched a movie for two hours.

sentences.zh: 昨天我洗了頭髮。
sentences.en: Yesterday I washed my hair.

sentences.zh: 每天我吃了早飯，開車去上班。
sentences.en: Every day after I eat breakfast, I drive to work.

sentences.zh: 我明天吃了飯，就去看電影。
sentences.en: Tomorrow after I eat, I'll go to a movie.

sentences.zh: 他下班了，現在去運動。
sentences.en: He has finished work and is going to exercise now.

sentences.zh: 我今天早上七點起床了。
sentences.en: I got up at seven this morning.

sentences.zh: 他晚上喜歡在家聽聽音樂。
sentences.en: In the evening he likes to listen to some music at home.

sentences.zh: 我們週末在公園走走。
sentences.en: On weekends we stroll in the park.

sentences.zh: 她有空的時候喜歡看看書。
sentences.en: When she has time she likes to read a bit.

sentences.zh: 你可以先試試這件外套。
sentences.en: You can try this coat on first.

sentences.zh: 我想問問這個蛋糕多少錢。
sentences.en: I'd like to ask how much this cake is.

sentences.zh: 星期天我們一起逛逛街吧。
sentences.en: On Sunday let's browse the shops together.

sentences.zh: 你應該多休息。
sentences.en: You should rest more.

sentences.zh: 你要多喝水，少喝咖啡。
sentences.en: You should drink more water and less coffee.

sentences.zh: 感冒的時候，要多喝水。
sentences.en: When you have a cold, drink more water.

sentences.zh: 你應該少吃冰淇淋。
sentences.en: You should eat less ice cream.

sentences.zh: 醫生說我要多運動。
sentences.en: The doctor says I should exercise more.

sentences.zh: 你的身體不太好，應該多運動。
sentences.en: Your health is not great; you should exercise more.

sentences.zh: 我應該少看電視，多看書。
sentences.en: I should watch less TV and read more.

sentences.zh: 他需要多吃水果。
sentences.en: He needs to eat more fruit.

sentences.zh: 最近太忙了，你要多注意身體。
sentences.en: You've been too busy lately; pay more attention to your health.

sentences.zh: 昨天我沒上班。
sentences.en: I didn't go to work yesterday.

sentences.zh: 她今天沒來學校。
sentences.en: She didn't come to school today.

sentences.zh: 我早上沒吃早飯。
sentences.en: I didn't eat breakfast this morning.

sentences.zh: 弟弟沒去醫院，他在家休息。
sentences.en: My younger brother didn't go to the hospital; he's resting at home.

sentences.zh: 他昨天沒有發燒。
sentences.en: He didn't have a fever yesterday.

sentences.zh: 我沒有咳嗽，可是頭很痛。
sentences.en: I don't have a cough, but my head hurts a lot.

sentences.zh: 我昨天沒有去看醫生。
sentences.en: I didn't go to see a doctor yesterday.

sentences.zh: 她沒買藥，因為她已經好多了。
sentences.en: She didn't buy medicine because she is already much better.

sentences.zh: 昨天我沒洗澡。
sentences.en: I didn't take a shower yesterday.

sentences.zh: 他又感冒了。
sentences.en: He has caught a cold again.

sentences.zh: 她又生病了。
sentences.en: She has gotten sick again.

sentences.zh: 你怎麼又來了？
sentences.en: How come you are here again?

sentences.zh: 弟弟又發燒了。
sentences.en: My younger brother has a fever again.

sentences.zh: 我今天又沒吃早飯了。
sentences.en: Once again I didn't eat breakfast today.

sentences.zh: 他又流鼻水了。
sentences.en: His nose is running again.

sentences.zh: 媽媽又去醫院了。
sentences.en: Mom has gone to the hospital again.

sentences.zh: 他在看電視。
sentences.en: He is watching TV.

sentences.zh: 高莉亞在做晚飯呢。
sentences.en: Gloria is cooking dinner.

sentences.zh: 我在寫論文，不能去玩。
sentences.en: I'm writing my thesis, so I can't go out and have fun.

sentences.zh: 他們在找機會去亞洲。
sentences.en: They are looking for a chance to go to Asia.

sentences.zh: 你們在做什麼？
sentences.en: What are you all doing?

sentences.zh: 我在練習說英文。
sentences.en: I'm practising speaking English.

sentences.zh: 媽媽在準備早飯。
sentences.en: Mom is preparing breakfast.

sentences.zh: 他在洗澡，你等一下吧。
sentences.en: He is taking a shower; wait a moment.

sentences.zh: 我快要畢業了。
sentences.en: I am about to graduate.

sentences.zh: 他快要回臺灣了。
sentences.en: He is about to return to Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 假期快要到了。
sentences.en: The vacation is almost here.

sentences.zh: 我的論文快要寫好了。
sentences.en: My thesis is almost finished.

sentences.zh: 天氣快要冷了。
sentences.en: The weather is about to turn cold.

sentences.zh: 我們快要放假了。
sentences.en: We are about to go on vacation.

sentences.zh: 我一下班就去運動。
sentences.en: As soon as I get off work, I go and exercise.

sentences.zh: 王先生一到家，王太太就去買東西了。
sentences.en: As soon as Mr. Wang got home, Mrs. Wang went out shopping.

sentences.zh: 他一有空就去游泳。
sentences.en: He goes swimming whenever he has time.

sentences.zh: 我一起床就洗澡。
sentences.en: I take a shower as soon as I get up.

sentences.zh: 媽媽一回來，我們就吃飯。
sentences.en: As soon as Mom comes back, we eat.

sentences.zh: 她一看電視就想吃東西。
sentences.en: She wants to eat as soon as she watches TV.

sentences.zh: 我去過臺灣。
sentences.en: I have been to Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 我沒去過日本。
sentences.en: I have never been to Japan.

sentences.zh: 你看過那個電影嗎？
sentences.en: Have you seen that movie?

sentences.zh: 她吃過臺灣的牛肉麵。
sentences.en: She has eaten Taiwanese beef noodle soup.

sentences.zh: 我哥哥去過亞洲的很多地方。
sentences.en: My older brother has been to many places in Asia.

sentences.zh: 我沒學過英文。
sentences.en: I have never studied English.

sentences.zh: 你玩過電腦遊戲嗎？
sentences.en: Have you ever played computer games?
